# Renata Vasquez — District Manager (District 7)

- **Relationship:** Marc's direct boss. Oversees **12 stores** including #4172.
- **Cadence:** weekly Monday check-in call (15 min); in-store district visit roughly every 3 weeks
  (last visit **2026-07-10**).
- **What she cares about right now:** **shrink** — she flags #4172's 1.9% every call and expects the
  [Shrink Reduction Plan](../projects/shrink-reduction-plan.md) to show movement by the next audit. Also
  pushing her [District Q3 Sales Contest](../projects/district-sales-contest.md).
- **How to work with her:** numbers first, no fluff. She wants the metric, the trend, and the one action
  Marc's taking — in that order. Don't bring her a problem without a proposed fix.
- **Sensitivities:** she gets heat from Regional Director [Dale Whitfield](../people/dale-whitfield.md) on
  shrink and payroll; if Marc misses on either, it rolls uphill onto her, so she's touchy about surprises.
  Give her a heads-up *before* bad news reaches Dale.
- **Owns (confidential):** the [Project Cardinal](../projects/cardinal.md) decision at the district level.
